Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove all
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners, advertisements, and
signage visible in the source image.

PRESERVE (must match source exactly)
- camera: aerial, facing street, fov 90
- highway road, 1-lane, asphalt
- sidewalks absent, curbs absent
- driveways: right; parking: none
- commercial building at center, 1 story, wood, brick, metal, pitched roof, shallow setback
- utilities: power lines, utility poles
- landscape: bare soil
- immutable elements: mountain
Keep this location instantly recognizable.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2015
Smartphone era fully arrived. A 2015 station — LED-lit canopy, digital price sign, video ads playing on every pump screen, and a big convenience store.

CONDITION: thriving — well-maintained, freshly painted, active business, clean lot

PERIOD DETAILS
- pay-at-pump with color screens and ads
- modern canopy with white LED lighting
- price sign showing gas around $2.45
- main sign: "Arco" branded gas station — Arco pole sign with price display and Arco colors on the canopy fascia
- window signs: '2 ENERGY DRINKS $5', 'ANY SIZE COFFEE $1'
- card-skimmer warning stickers on the pumps
- a chalkboard A-frame sign advertising the coffee bar
Typography: minimalist flat sans-serif, simplified modern logos.
Sign text is only what appears in quotes — do not turn other words from this prompt into signage.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 7 people TOTAL: 3 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 2 opposite sidewalk mid-block, 2 distant, far end of block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- a woman scrolling her smartphone while leaning on her crossover
- a customer watching the pump screen ads while fueling
- a dog walker with three dogs
Clothing: men in beards, slim-fit plaid shirts; women in ankle boots, statement necklaces. Fashion palette: coral, mint green, navy. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes. Any customer activity at the pumps happens next to a parked vehicle — no one refuels without a car present.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 3 period vehicles, all different:
- 2014-2019 Kia Soul — boxy urban hatchback — blue
- 2014-2021 Subaru Outback — rugged wagon crossover — dark red
- 2013-2016 Mazda CX-5 — flowing KODO-design crossover — black
Parked with gaps; no vehicle newer than 2015.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: all parked on the RIGHT side of the street with gaps between them. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: yellow center line, white edge lines, high-visibility crosswalks
- utilities: overhead power lines common, undergrounding in new developments, fiber optic lines on poles

TREES
- deciduous tree at left: very young sapling
- deciduous tree at right: very young sapling
- deciduous tree at background: established tree, modest canopy
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the source photo.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — digital — DSLR or smartphone camera look.
Color: high saturation. Grain: clean, minimal noise.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
